response.answer: Header pressure is falling while filter dP rises and pump discharge stays flat, so the pressure-path rule points to filter loading. The reservoir level is also rising, which means something is entering the oil. In this system the likely source is cooling water through a tube leak in cooler E-101A, which emulsifies the oil and loads the filter (as in INC-2024-017). Confirm with an oil sample photo per SOP-LO-04 §2.
